newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on weak demand, Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends mixed on weak demand, Tokyo.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended mixed on weak consumer demand and a fall in Tokyo futures, traders said.

At the close, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted market indicator price for November RSS 1 buyer at 313 cents ($1.25) a kg, unchanged from Thursday. November SMR 20 buyer fell two cents to 305.50 cents.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at around 304, SMR CV at 362-363, SMR L at 342-343, SMR5 at 310-311, SMR10 at 302-303 and drum latex at 235.
Traders said trading was slow, restricted to short-covering for earlier sales, while sentiment only aided by news of rains in northern growing areas and Thailand and Indonesia.
"The direction of the market next week is going to depend pretty much on the weather," said a trader.
The Malaysian Metereological Services Department said on Friday it expected a rainy week ahead.
The INRO five-day average was 241.56 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Oct 3 from 241.88 on Oct 2. The daily indicator was 241.12 against 241.24.
